<!-- wp:html -->
<!--
  FIKA home page hero + header
  Paste into a "Custom HTML" block on your Home page.
  Nothing to replace: the candy photo is built into this code.
  Your font (NF Le Petit Cochon) is already built into this code.
  Set this page's template to "Blank" (or hide the theme header) so there is only one header.
-->
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Fanwood+Text&display=swap');

@font-face {
  font-family: 'NF Le Petit Cochon';
  src: url(data:font/woff;base64,) format('woff');
  font-display: swap;
}

/* Remove the white gap the theme leaves above the hero */
body:has(.fika-hero) { margin-top: 0 !important; padding-top: 0 !important; }
body:has(.fika-hero) :is(.wp-site-blocks, main, .site-main, .site-content, #content, #primary, .content-area, .entry-content, .post-content, article, .hentry) { padding-top: 0 !important; margin-top: 0 !important; }
.fika-hero { margin-top: 0 !important; margin-block-start: 0 !important; }
/* Beat the theme's own centred-column rule (it uses !important) so the hero spans the whole screen */
body .fika-hero.fika-hero { width: 100vw !important; max-width: 100vw !important; margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw) !important; margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw) !important; }

/* Hide the theme's big page title ("Home") on this page */
body:has(.fika-hero) :is(.entry-title, .page-title, .wp-block-post-title, .page-header, .entry-header) { display: none !important; }

.fika-hero {
  --fika-blue: #004aad;
  --fika-pink: #fdeaf2;
  position: relative;
  width: 100vw;
  max-width: 100vw;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  min-height: 100vh;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--fika-pink) url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center bottom / cover no-repeat;
}

/* Photo stays still while the page scrolls over it (no script needed) */
@keyframes fikaPhotoHold {
  from { background-position: 50% 100%; }
  to   { background-position: 50% calc(100% + 100vh); }
}
@supports (animation-timeline: scroll()) {
  .fika-hero { animation: fikaPhotoHold linear both; animation-timeline: scroll(root block); animation-range: 0 100vh; }
}
@supports not (animation-timeline: scroll()) {
  .fika-hero { background-attachment: fixed; background-position: center bottom; }
}
.fika-hero * { box-sizing: border-box; }

/* Announcement banner (always visible, always blue) */
.fika-banner, .fika-banner * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.fika-banner {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  transform: none;
  min-height: 45px;
  z-index: 1001;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  background: #004aad;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: 'Fanwood Text', Georgia, serif;
  font-variant: small-caps;
  font-size: 17px;
  letter-spacing: .02em;
  line-height: 1.25;
  text-align: center;
}
.admin-bar .fika-banner { top: 32px; }
@media (max-width: 782px) { .admin-bar .fika-banner { top: 46px; } }

/* Fail-safe: the header is pink unless the script confirms we are at the very top of the page */
.fika-header:not(.fika-top) {
  background: rgba(253, 234, 242, .96);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 74, 173, .12);
  padding: 14px 10%;
}
.fika-header:not(.fika-top) .fika-logo { font-size: 40px; }
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .fika-header:not(.fika-top) { padding: 12px 6%; }
  .fika-header:not(.fika-top) .fika-logo { font-size: 32px; }
}

/* No-script fallback: pink fades in on scroll even if the script is blocked */
@keyframes fikaPinkIn {
  from { background-color: rgba(253,234,242,0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(0,74,173,0); }
  to   { background-color: rgba(253,234,242,.96); box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,74,173,.12); }
}
@supports (animation-timeline: scroll()) {
  html:not(.fika-js) .fika-header { animation: fikaPinkIn linear both; animation-timeline: scroll(root block); animation-range: 0 40px; }
}

/* Banner hide / show (used by the BANNER_MODE setting in the script) */
.fika-banner { transition: transform .25s ease, opacity .25s ease, background-color .3s ease, color .3s ease; }
/* At the very top of the page the banner is see-through with blue text; blue bar appears once scrolling starts */
.fika-banner.fika-banner-hidden { transform: translateY(-110%); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.fika-header { transition: background .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease, padding .25s ease, transform .3s ease, opacity .25s ease; }
.fika-header.fika-header-hidden { transform: translateY(-160%) !important; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.fika-header { transition: background .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, padding .25s ease, top .25s ease; }

/* Header (stays on screen while scrolling) */
.fika-header, .fika-header * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.fika-header {
  --fika-blue: #004aad;
  --fika-pink: #fdeaf2;
  --fika-banner-h: 40px;
  position: fixed;
  top: var(--fika-banner-h); left: 0; right: 0;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  transform: none;
  z-index: 1000;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 30px 10% 0;
  transition: background .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, padding .25s ease;
}
.fika-header.fika-scrolled {
  background: rgba(253, 234, 242, .94);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 74, 173, .12);
  padding: 14px 10%;
}
.fika-header.fika-scrolled .fika-logo { font-size: 40px; }
.admin-bar .fika-header { top: calc(32px + var(--fika-banner-h)); }
@media (max-width: 782px) { .admin-bar .fika-header { top: calc(46px + var(--fika-banner-h)); } }
.fika-logo {
  font-family: 'NF Le Petit Cochon', cursive;
  font-variant: small-caps;
  font-size: 56px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--fika-blue);
  text-decoration: none;
  justify-self: start;
  transition: font-size .25s ease;
}
.fika-nav { display: flex; gap: 80px; }
.fika-nav a {
  font-family: 'Bebas Neue', Impact, sans-serif;
  font-size: 28px;
  letter-spacing: .01em;
  color: var(--fika-blue);
  text-decoration: none;
  padding-bottom: 4px;
  border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
  transition: border-color .18s ease;
}
.fika-nav a:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--fika-blue); }
.fika-cart { justify-self: end; color: var(--fika-blue); display: flex; }
.fika-cart svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; }

/* Content */
.fika-content {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding: 0 10% 56px;
  max-width: 900px;
}
.fika-title {
  font-family: 'NF Le Petit Cochon', cursive;
  font-variant: small-caps;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 84px);
  line-height: 1.15;
  color: var(--fika-blue);
  margin: 0 0 22px;
  max-width: 600px;
}
.fika-text {
  font-family: 'Fanwood Text', Georgia, serif;
  font-variant: small-caps;
  font-size: clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 19px);
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: #fff;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
  max-width: 640px;
  margin: 0 0 34px;
}
.fika-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--fika-blue);
  color: #fff;
  font-family: 'Open Sans', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px;
  letter-spacing: .02em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 13px 26px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}
.fika-btn:hover { background: #003a8a; }


/* Logo: letters jump in a wave on hover */
.fika-logo span { display: inline-block; }
.fika-logo:hover span { animation: fika-jump 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * .11s); }
@keyframes fika-jump {
  0%   { transform: translateY(0); }
  18%  { transform: translateY(-16px) scale(1.12); }
  36%  { transform: translateY(2px); }
  46%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .fika-logo:hover span { animation: none; } }

/* Cart: candies fly out on hover */
.fika-cart { position: relative; padding: 8px; margin: -8px; }
.fika-cart svg { transform-origin: 50% 80%; }
.fika-candies { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 0; height: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 5; }
.fika-candies i { position: absolute; left: -5px; top: -5px; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); opacity: 0; }
.fika-candies i.pill { width: 15px; height: 8px; left: -7px; top: -4px; border-radius: 6px; }
.fika-candies i.wrap { width: 11px; height: 8px; left: -5px; top: -4px; border-radius: 3px; }
.fika-candies i.wrap::before, .fika-candies i.wrap::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; width: 6px; height: 8px; background: var(--c); }
.fika-candies i.wrap::before { left: -6px; clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 0 50%, 100% 100%); }
.fika-candies i.wrap::after { right: -6px; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 50%, 0 100%); }
.fika-cart:hover svg { animation: fika-wiggle .5s ease-in-out; }
.fika-cart:hover .fika-candies i { animation: fika-fly 1s ease-out infinite; animation-delay: var(--d); }
@keyframes fika-fly {
  0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translate(0, 0) scale(.3) rotate(0deg); }
  15%  { opacity: 1; }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)) scale(1) rotate(var(--r)); }
}
@keyframes fika-wiggle {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  25% { transform: rotate(-9deg); }
  75% { transform: rotate(9deg); }
}
@media (hover: none) { .fika-hero { min-height: 620px; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .fika-cart:hover svg, .fika-cart:hover .fika-candies i { animation: none; }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .fika-hero { min-height: 620px; }
  .fika-banner, .fika-header { --fika-banner-h: 34px; }
  .fika-banner { font-size: 14px; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 12px; }
  .fika-header { padding: 18px 6% 0; }
  .fika-header.fika-scrolled { padding: 12px 6%; }
  .fika-header.fika-scrolled .fika-logo { font-size: 32px; }
  .fika-logo { font-size: 40px; }
  .fika-nav { gap: 28px; }
  .fika-nav a { font-size: 22px; }
  .fika-cart svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
  .fika-content { padding: 0 6% 40px; }
  .fika-btn { font-size: 13.5px; padding: 11px 22px; }
}
</style>
<style>
.fika-banner { overflow: hidden !important; justify-content: flex-start !important; padding-left: 0 !important; padding-right: 0 !important; }
.fika-banner .fika-ticker { display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; padding-left: 100vw; animation: fikaTicker 22s linear infinite; }
.fika-banner:hover .fika-ticker { animation-play-state: paused; }
@keyframes fikaTicker { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-100%); } }
@media (max-width: 700px) { .fika-banner .fika-ticker { animation-duration: 14s; } }
</style>

<div class="fika-banner"><span class="fika-ticker">Due to unforeseen regional circumstances, we are unable to deliver to Nabatieh and bordering cities.</span></div>

<div class="fika-header">
  <a class="fika-logo" href="/" aria-label="Fika"><span style="--i:0" aria-hidden="true">F</span><span style="--i:1" aria-hidden="true">i</span><span style="--i:2" aria-hidden="true">k</span><span style="--i:3" aria-hidden="true">a</span></a>
  <nav class="fika-nav">
    <a href="/">Home</a>
    <a href="/shop">Shop</a>
  </nav>
  <a class="fika-cart" href="/cart" aria-label="Cart">
    <span class="fika-candies" aria-hidden="true"><i class="pill" style="--dx:-46px;--dy:-40px;--r:-260deg;--c:#ff6fa5;--d:0s"></i><i class="dot" style="--dx:-18px;--dy:-58px;--r:200deg;--c:#ffd23f;--d:0.08s"></i><i class="wrap" style="--dx:20px;--dy:-56px;--r:-180deg;--c:#4aa8ff;--d:0.16s"></i><i class="dot" style="--dx:50px;--dy:-34px;--r:240deg;--c:#ff4d4d;--d:0.04s"></i><i class="pill" style="--dx:58px;--dy:-4px;--r:-300deg;--c:#7ad67a;--d:0.20s"></i><i class="wrap" style="--dx:46px;--dy:30px;--r:220deg;--c:#ff9f43;--d:0.12s"></i><i class="dot" style="--dx:14px;--dy:52px;--r:-200deg;--c:#c77dff;--d:0.24s"></i><i class="pill" style="--dx:-24px;--dy:50px;--r:260deg;--c:#ffd23f;--d:0.06s"></i><i class="dot" style="--dx:-52px;--dy:20px;--r:-240deg;--c:#4aa8ff;--d:0.18s"></i><i class="wrap" style="--dx:-58px;--dy:-10px;--r:180deg;--c:#ff6fa5;--d:0.28s"></i></span>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <path d="M5 8h14l-1 12H6L5 8z"></path>
      <path d="M9 8V6a3 3 0 0 1 6 0v2"></path>
    </svg>
  </a>
</div>

<div class="fika-hero">
  <div class="fika-content">
    <h1 class="fika-title">Stockholm's finest sweets, in Lebanon</h1>
    <p class="fika-text">Experience authentic, clean-ingredient Swedish pick-and-mix. Hand-selected, gelatin-free, and imported fresh for your afternoon fika.</p>
    <a class="fika-btn" href="/shop">Explore the shop</a>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- FIKA hero: googly eyes on the skull candies that follow the cursor (or finger).
     Eye positions are in the hero photo's own pixels (1920 x 1072).
     Note: the script avoids the logical-and operator and the less-than sign on purpose.
     WordPress rewrites those inside page content, which breaks the script. -->
<style>
.fika-hero .fika-content { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
.fika-eyes { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; }
.fika-eye {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, #fff 58%, #f1e6ec 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(27, 42, 74, .35), inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(27, 42, 74, .25);
  transition: transform .09s ease-in;
  will-change: transform;
}
.fika-eye.fika-blink { transform: scaleY(.08); }
.fika-pupil {
  position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 52%; height: 52%;
  margin: -26% 0 0 -26%; border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%, #fff 0 14%, #1b2a4a 17% 100%);
  will-change: transform;
}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  var hero = document.querySelector('.fika-hero');
  if (!hero) return;
  if (hero.querySelector('.fika-eyes')) return;

  var IMG_W = 1920, IMG_H = 1072;
  var EYE_R = 7.5;   // eye radius in photo pixels
  var SKULLS = [
    [[338,498],[365,490]], [[575,493],[602,493]], [[921,497],[937,520]], [[1060,482],[1043,507]],
    [[1167,504],[1194,499]], [[33,614],[55,636]], [[197,597],[224,600]], [[676,587],[699,598]],
    [[1266,598],[1284,622]], [[743,704],[745,733]], [[1775,647],[1756,671]], [[1396,782],[1424,784]],
    [[1493,773],[1519,763]], [[473,800],[467,828]], [[235,885],[211,898]], [[382,889],[411,897]],
    [[745,827],[775,841]], [[844,879],[865,887]], [[560,923],[538,947]], [[1256,884],[1275,907]],
    [[1635,952],[1660,946]], [[1260,1014],[1292,1016]]
  ];

  var layer = document.createElement('div');
  layer.className = 'fika-eyes';
  layer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  var eyes = [];
  SKULLS.forEach(function (pair, s) {
    pair.forEach(function (p) {
      var e = document.createElement('i');
      e.className = 'fika-eye';
      var pu = document.createElement('i');
      pu.className = 'fika-pupil';
      e.appendChild(pu);
      layer.appendChild(e);
      eyes.push({ el: e, pu: pu, ix: p[0], iy: p[1], skull: s, cx: 0, cy: 0, r: 0, px: 0, py: 0 });
    });
  });
  hero.insertBefore(layer, hero.firstChild);

  var scrollAnim = !!(window.CSS ? (CSS.supports ? CSS.supports('animation-timeline: scroll()') : false) : false);
  var reduce = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches : false;

  // Work out where the photo is drawn inside the hero, the same way the page CSS places it
  function layout() {
    var W = hero.clientWidth, H = hero.clientHeight;
    var fixed = getComputedStyle(hero).backgroundAttachment === 'fixed';
    var vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;
    var bw = fixed ? vw : W, bh = fixed ? vh : H;
    var s = Math.max(bw / IMG_W, bh / IMG_H);
    var ox = (bw - IMG_W * s) / 2, oy = bh - IMG_H * s;
    if (fixed) {
      var rc = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      ox -= rc.left; oy -= rc.top;
    } else if (scrollAnim) {
      // The photo holds still while the page scrolls (keyframes fikaPhotoHold)
      var y = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0;
      oy += Math.max(0, Math.min(y, vh));
    }
    var r = Math.max(4.5, EYE_R * s);
    eyes.forEach(function (e) {
      e.r = r;
      e.cx = ox + e.ix * s;
      e.cy = oy + e.iy * s;
      e.el.style.width = e.el.style.height = (2 * r) + 'px';
      e.el.style.left = (e.cx - r) + 'px';
      e.el.style.top = (e.cy - r) + 'px';
    });
  }

  // Where the eyes look: the pointer, or a wandering spot when nobody is pointing
  var tx = null, ty = null, lastMove = 0, wander = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  function onPoint(e) {
    var pt = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
    if (!pt) return;
    tx = pt.clientX; ty = pt.clientY; lastMove = Date.now();
    kick();
  }
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPoint, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPoint, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('touchmove', onPoint, { passive: true });

  function newWander() {
    var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    wander.x = Math.cos(a); wander.y = Math.sin(a);
    kick();
  }

  var running = false, visible = true;
  function kick() { if (!running) { if (visible) { running = true; requestAnimationFrame(frame); } } }

  function frame() {
    running = false;
    var rc = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
    var idle = tx === null ? true : (Date.now() - lastMove > 4000);
    var moving = false;
    eyes.forEach(function (e) {
      var max = e.r * 0.42, gx, gy;
      if (idle) {
        gx = wander.x * max; gy = wander.y * max;
      } else {
        var dx = tx - (rc.left + e.cx), dy = ty - (rc.top + e.cy);
        var d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
        var k = Math.min(1, d / 60) * max / d;
        gx = dx * k; gy = dy * k;
      }
      e.px += (gx - e.px) * 0.25;
      e.py += (gy - e.py) * 0.25;
      if (Math.abs(gx - e.px) + Math.abs(gy - e.py) > 0.05) moving = true;
      e.pu.style.transform = 'translate(' + e.px.toFixed(2) + 'px,' + e.py.toFixed(2) + 'px)';
    });
    if (moving) kick();
  }

  // Each skull blinks now and then, both eyes together
  function blink() {
    if (visible) {
      var s = Math.floor(Math.random() * SKULLS.length);
      eyes.forEach(function (e) { if (e.skull === s) e.el.classList.add('fika-blink'); });
      setTimeout(function () {
        eyes.forEach(function (e) { if (e.skull === s) e.el.classList.remove('fika-blink'); });
      }, 140);
    }
    setTimeout(blink, 700 + Math.random() * 1600);
  }

  layout();
  newWander();
  if (!reduce) {
    setInterval(function () { if (tx === null) newWander(); else if (Date.now() - lastMove > 4000) newWander(); }, 2200);
    setTimeout(blink, 1500);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { layout(); kick(); });
  window.addEventListener('load', layout);
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function () { layout(); kick(); }, { passive: true });
  setTimeout(layout, 400); setTimeout(layout, 1500);
  if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(layout).observe(hero);
  if (window.IntersectionObserver) {
    new IntersectionObserver(function (en) { visible = en[0].isIntersecting; if (visible) kick(); }).observe(hero);
  }
})();
</script>

<!-- FIKA fish cursor: a Swedish fish cut from the hero photo, with a white sticker outline.
     Normal fish everywhere; tilted fish over links and buttons; text cursor in text fields. -->
<style>
html, body, body * {
  cursor: url(data:image/png;base64,) 3 2, auto !important;
  cursor: image-set(url(data:image/png;base64,) 1x, url(data:image/png;base64,) 2x) 3 2, auto !important;
}
body a, body a *, body button, body button *, body summary, body summary *, body label, body select,
body [role="button"], body [role="button"] *, body input[type="submit"], body input[type="button"],
body input[type="checkbox"], body input[type="radio"], body [onclick] {
  cursor: url(data:image/png;base64,) 5 9, pointer !important;
  cursor: image-set(url(data:image/png;base64,) 1x, url(data:image/png;base64,) 2x) 5 9, pointer !important;
}
body input[type="text"], body input[type="email"], body input[type="search"], body input[type="tel"],
body input[type="number"], body input[type="password"], body input:not([type]), body textarea,
body [contenteditable="true"] { cursor: text !important; }
</style>

<!-- FIKA fish bite: on each mouse click the fish chomps (jaws open and snap shut twice),
     lunges forward, and pops a little "nom!" with sugar crumbs.
     The real cursor is hidden for the half second the animated copy plays. -->

(function () {
  // Banner behaviour: 'always' (stays visible) | 'hide-on-scroll-up' | 'hide-on-scroll-down'
  var BANNER_MODE = 'always';
  // Pink Fika / Home / Shop bar: 'hide-on-scroll-up' | 'always'
  var HEADER_MODE = 'always';
  var hdHidden = false;

  try { console.log('[FIKA header] script running v8'); window.__fikaHeroRan = true; } catch (e) {}

  try { document.documentElement.classList.add('fika-js'); } catch (e) {}
  var h = document.querySelector('.fika-header');
  var bn = document.querySelector('.fika-banner');
  var hero = document.querySelector('.fika-hero');
  if (!h) return;

  // Move banner and header straight under <body> so the theme's layout can't squeeze or clip them
  try {
    if (bn && bn.parentNode !== document.body) document.body.appendChild(bn);
    if (h.parentNode !== document.body) document.body.appendChild(h);
  } catch (e) {}

  var bnHidden = false;
  var lastY = 0;
  var elY = 0;
  var ticking = false;
  var canParallax = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(hover: hover)').matches;

  // Works whether the page scrolls normally or inside a theme container

      document.documentElement ? document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0 : 0,
      document.body ? document.body.scrollTop || 0 : 0,
      elY,
      heroY()

  }
  // Position measured from the hero itself: works whatever element the theme scrolls
  function heroY() {
    try { return hero ? Math.max(0, -hero.getBoundingClientRect().top) : 0; } catch (e) { return 0; }
  }

  function placeHeader() {
    if (bn) h.style.setProperty('--fika-banner-h', (bnHidden ? 0 : bn.offsetHeight) + 'px');
  }
  function setBanner(show) {
    if (!bn || bnHidden === !show) return;
    bnHidden = !show;
    if (bnHidden) bn.classList.add('fika-banner-hidden'); else bn.classList.remove('fika-banner-hidden');
    placeHeader();
  }

  // Stretch an element edge to edge, whatever the theme's column is doing
  function fitX(el) {
    el.style.setProperty('margin-left', '0px', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('margin-right', '0px', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('max-width', 'none', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('width', document.documentElement.clientWidth + 'px', 'important');
    var left = el.getBoundingClientRect().left;
    el.style.setProperty('margin-left', (-left) + 'px', 'important');
  }
  // Remove any gap the theme leaves above the hero
  function fit() {
    if (!hero) return;
    try {
      fitX(hero);
      hero.style.setProperty('margin-top', '0px', 'important');
      var top = hero.getBoundingClientRect().top + getY();
      if (top > 0 && top < 320) hero.style.setProperty('margin-top', (-top) + 'px', 'important');
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function update() {
    ticking = false;
    var y = getY();

    // Pink background from the very first pixel of scrolling; see-through only at the very top
    if (y > 1) h.classList.remove('fika-top'); else h.classList.add('fika-top');

      var hdy = y - lastY;
      if (y <= 30) hdHidden = false;
      else if (Math.abs(hdy) > 4) hdHidden = hdy < 0;

      h.style.setProperty('opacity', hdHidden ? '0' : '1', 'important');
      h.style.setProperty('pointer-events', hdHidden ? 'none' : 'auto', 'important');
    }

    if (bn ? BANNER_MODE !== 'always' : false) {
      var dy = y - lastY;
      if (y <= 30) setBanner(true);
      else if (Math.abs(dy) > 4) {
        if (BANNER_MODE === 'hide-on-scroll-up') setBanner(dy > 0);
        else setBanner(dy < 0);
      }

  window.addEventListener('touchmove', function () { setTimeout(update, 30); }, { passive: true });
  function onScroll() {
    if (!ticking) { ticking = true; window.requestAnimationFrame(update); }

  window.addEventListener('resize', refresh);

  setTimeout(refresh, 400);
  setTimeout(refresh, 1500);
  setInterval(update, 250);   // safety net in case a scroll event is missed

(function () {

  // ======== YOUR CANDY LIST (name, gelatin true = contains pork gelatin, desc not shown, img = photo URL) ========

    { name:'Fizzy Cola',      gelatin:true,  img:'' },
    { name:'Loose Teeth',     gelatin:true,  img:'' },
    { name:'Fizzy Pop',       gelatin:true,  img:'' },
    { name:'Raspberry Bites', gelatin:true,  img:'' },
    { name:'Sample candy 5',  gelatin:false, img:'' },
    { name:'Sample candy 6',  gelatin:false, img:'' },
    { name:'Sample candy 7',  gelatin:false, img:'' },
    { name:'Sample candy 8',  gelatin:false, img:'' }

  var grid = document.getElementById('mxGrid');
  if (!grid) return;
  var KEY = 'fika_bag_v1', bag = {}, meta = {};
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  PRODUCTS.forEach(function (p, i) { p.id = 'p' + i; p.hue = (i * 47 + 330) % 360; });
  function loadBag() { try { var s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null'); if (s) { bag = s.bag || {}; meta = s.meta || {}; } } catch (e) {} }
  loadBag();
  // The bag is shared with the Ready-Mix block: items keep their own name and price per 100g

    Object.keys(bag).forEach(function (id) { var p = byId(id); if (p.name) meta[id] = { name: p.name, price: p.price || PRICE_100G }; });
    Object.keys(meta).forEach(function (id) { if (!bag[id]) delete meta[id]; });

    try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fikabag', { detail: 'mix' })); } catch (e) {}
  }
  window.addEventListener('fikabag', function (e) { if (e.detail === 'mix') return; loadBag(); render(); });
  function money(n) { return '$' + n.toFixed(2); }
  function gText(g) { return g >= 1000 ? (g / 1000) + ' kg' : g + 'g'; }
  function cost() { var c = 0; for (var k in bag) c += bag[k] / 100 * (byId(k).price || PRICE_100G); return c; }
  function total() { var t = 0; for (var k in bag) t += bag[k]; return t; }
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"' }[c]; }); }
  function byId(id) { for (var i = 0; i < PRODUCTS.length; i++) if (PRODUCTS[i].id === id) return PRODUCTS[i]; return meta[id] || {}; }
  function pixel(ev, x) { try { if (typeof window.fbq === 'function') window.fbq('track', ev, x); } catch (e) {} }

  function img(p) {
    if (p.img) return '<img loading="lazy" src="' + esc(p.img) + '" alt="' + esc(p.name) + '">';
    var s = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) s += '<i style="--x:' + (22 + ((i * 29 + p.hue) % 46)) + '%;--y:' + (24 + ((i * 41 + p.hue / 2) % 46)) + '%;--r:' + (((i * 67 + p.hue) % 120) - 60) + 'deg"></i>';
    return '<div class="mx-ph" style="--h:' + p.hue + '">' + s + '</div>';
  }
  function renderGrid() {
    $('mxCount').textContent = PRODUCTS.length + ' products';
    var keep = grid.scrollLeft;
    grid.innerHTML = PRODUCTS.map(function (p) {
      var g = bag[p.id] || 0;
      return '<article class="mx-card' + (g ? ' has' : '') + '" data-id="' + p.id + '"><div class="mx-img">' +
        (p.gelatin ? '<span class="mx-badge">Pork Gelatin</span>' : '') + img(p) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="mx-body"><h3 class="mx-name">' + esc(p.name) + '</h3><div class="mx-price">' + money(p.price || PRICE_100G) + '</div>' +
        (g ? '<div class="mx-pill"><button type="button" data-a="-" aria-label="Less">−</button><span>' + gText(g) + '</span><button type="button" data-a="+" aria-label="More">+</button></div>'

  // ---- horizontal scroll: arrows, drag, progress ----

    prog.style.width = w + '%';
    prog.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (max > 0 ? (x / max) * (100 / w * 100 - 100) : 0) + '%)';

  next.addEventListener('click', function () { by(1); });

    else { bag[id] = Math.max(0, cur - STEP); if (!bag[id]) delete bag[id]; }
    save(); render();
  });

  var drawer = $('mxDrawer'), veil = $('mxVeil'), fab = $('mxFab');
  function openD() { drawer.classList.add('on'); veil.classList.add('on'); }

  fab.addEventListener('click', openD); veil.addEventListener('click', closeD); $('mxClose').addEventListener('click', closeD);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeD(); });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target.closest('.fika-cart')) { e.preventDefault(); openD(); } });
  $('mxClear').addEventListener('click', function () { bag = {}; save(); render(); });
  $('mxItems').addEventListener('click', function (e) { var b = e.target.closest('.mx-rm'); if (!b) return; delete bag[b.getAttribute('data-id')]; save(); render(); });
  $('mxGo').setAttribute('href', CHECKOUT_URL);
  $('mxGo').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var sub = cost(); if (!sub) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
    pixel('InitiateCheckout', { value: sub + DELIVERY, currency: 'USD', num_items: Object.keys(bag).length });
  });

  function renderBag() {
    var html = '';
    Object.keys(bag).forEach(function (id) {

    });
    $('mxItems').innerHTML = html || '<div class="mx-none">Your bag is empty.</div>';
    var g = total(), sub = cost(), has = g > 0;
    var kg = (g / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' kg';

  }
  function render() { renderGrid(); renderBag(); }

  function fitX(el) {

    el.style.setProperty('max-width', 'none', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('width', document.documentElement.clientWidth + 'px', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('margin-left', (-el.getBoundingClientRect().left) + 'px', 'important');
  }

  setTimeout(fitAll, 400); setTimeout(fitAll, 1500);
  render(); fitAll(); place(); setTimeout(place, 500);

  if (AUTO_FROM_WOOCOMMERCE && window.fetch) {
    fetch('/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=100&orderby=menu_order&order=asc', { credentials: 'same-origin' })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('no store api'); return r.json(); })

          var price = w.prices ? parseInt(w.prices.price, 10) / Math.pow(10, minor) : PRICE_100G;
          var labels = (w.tags || []).concat(w.categories || []).map(function (t) { return (t.name + ' ' + t.slug).toLowerCase(); }).join(' ');
          var neg = /(no|free|without|non)[ -]*(pork)?[ -]*gelatin|gelatin[ -]*(free|less)/.test(labels);
          return { id: 'w' + w.id, name: dec(w.name), gelatin: labels.indexOf(GELATIN_WORD) !== -1 && !neg,

      })

  }
  try { console.log('[FIKA mix page] ready'); } catch (e) {}
  } catch (err) { try { console.log('[FIKA mix page] error', err); } catch (e) {} }
})();

(function () {

  var grid = document.getElementById('rmGrid'); if (!grid) return;

  function read() { try { var s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null'); if (s) return { bag: s.bag || {}, meta: s.meta || {} }; } catch (e) {} return { bag: {}, meta: {} }; }
  function write(st) { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(st)); } catch (e) {} try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fikabag', { detail: 'ready' })); } catch (e) {} }
  function money(n) { return '$' + n.toFixed(2); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"' }[c]; }); }
  function gText(g) { return g >= 1000 ? (g / 1000) + ' kg' : g + 'g'; }

  function setIds() { PRODUCTS.forEach(function (p, i) { if (!p.id) p.id = 'r' + i; p.hue = p.hue != null ? p.hue : (i * 61 + 340) % 360; }); }

    var s = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) s += '<i style="--x:' + (22 + ((i * 29 + p.hue) % 46)) + '%;--y:' + (24 + ((i * 41 + p.hue / 2) % 46)) + '%;--r:' + (((i * 67 + p.hue) % 120) - 60) + 'deg"></i>';
    return '<div class="mx-ph" style="--h:' + p.hue + '">' + s + '</div>';
  }
  function sorted() { return PRODUCTS.slice(); }
  function render() {
    var st = read(), keep = grid.scrollLeft;
    $('rmCount').textContent = PRODUCTS.length + ' product' + (PRODUCTS.length === 1 ? '' : 's');
    grid.innerHTML = sorted().map(function (p) {
      var g = st.bag[p.id] || 0;
      return '<article class="mx-card' + (g ? ' has' : '') + '" data-id="' + esc(p.id) + '"><div class="mx-img"><span class="mx-badge">' + (p.gelatin ? 'Pork Gelatin' : 'Gelatin Free') + '</span>' + img(p) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="mx-body"><h3 class="mx-name">' + esc(p.name) + '</h3><div class="mx-price">From ' + money(p.price) + '</div>' +
        (g ? '<div class="mx-pill"><button type="button" data-a="-" aria-label="Less">−</button><span>' + (g / BAG_G) + ' × ' + BAG_G + 'g</span><button type="button" data-a="+" aria-label="More">+</button></div>'

    }).join('');
    grid.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto'; grid.scrollLeft = keep; grid.style.scrollBehavior = '';
    place();
  }
  function byId(id) { for (var i = 0; i < PRODUCTS.length; i++) if (PRODUCTS[i].id === id) return PRODUCTS[i]; return {}; }
  grid.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest('button[data-a]'); if (!b) return;
    var id = b.closest('.mx-card').getAttribute('data-id'), p = byId(id), st = read(), cur = st.bag[id] || 0;
    if (b.getAttribute('data-a') === '+') {
      st.bag[id] = cur + BAG_G; st.meta[id] = { name: p.name, price: p.price / (BAG_G / 100) };
      pixel('AddToCart', { value: p.price, currency: 'USD', content_name: p.name });

    write(st); render();
  });
  window.addEventListener('fikabag', function (e) { if (e.detail !== 'ready') render(); });

  // ---- horizontal scroll ----
  var prev = $('rmPrev'), next = $('rmNext'), prog = $('rmProg');
  function place() {
    var max = grid.scrollWidth - grid.clientWidth, x = grid.scrollLeft;
    prev.disabled = x < 4; next.disabled = x > max - 4;
    var w = Math.min(100, Math.max(8, grid.clientWidth / Math.max(grid.scrollWidth, 1) * 100));
    prog.style.width = w + '%';
    prog.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (max > 0 ? (x / max) * (100 / w * 100 - 100) : 0) + '%)';
    var i0 = grid.querySelector('.mx-img');
    if (i0) { var top = i0.offsetTop + i0.offsetHeight / 2; prev.style.top = next.style.top = top + 'px'; }
  }
  function step() { var c = grid.querySelector('.mx-card'); return c ? c.getBoundingClientRect().width + parseFloat(getComputedStyle(grid).columnGap || 0) : grid.clientWidth * .8; }
  prev.addEventListener('click', function () { grid.scrollBy({ left: -step() * (window.innerWidth > 1100 ? 2 : 1), behavior: 'smooth' }); });
  next.addEventListener('click', function () { grid.scrollBy({ left: step() * (window.innerWidth > 1100 ? 2 : 1), behavior: 'smooth' }); });
  grid.addEventListener('scroll', place, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', place);
  var down = false, sx = 0, sl = 0, moved = false;
  grid.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse' || e.target.closest('button')) return; down = true; moved = false; sx = e.clientX; sl = grid.scrollLeft; });
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (!down) return; var dx = e.clientX - sx; if (Math.abs(dx) > 4) { moved = true; grid.classList.add('drag'); } if (moved) grid.scrollLeft = sl - dx; });

  function fitX(el) {
    el.style.setProperty('margin-left', '0px', 'important'); el.style.setProperty('margin-right', '0px', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('max-width', 'none', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('width', document.documentElement.clientWidth + 'px', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('margin-left', (-el.getBoundingClientRect().left) + 'px', 'important');
  }
  function fitAll() { try { fitX($('rmPage')); place(); } catch (e) {} }
  window.addEventListener('resize', fitAll); window.addEventListener('load', fitAll);
  setTimeout(fitAll, 400); setTimeout(fitAll, 1500);
  render(); fitAll();

  if (AUTO_FROM_WOOCOMMERCE && window.fetch) {
    fetch('/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=100&orderby=menu_order&order=asc', { credentials: 'same-origin' })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('no store api'); return r.json(); })
      .then(function (list) {
        var ta = document.createElement('textarea'), dec = function (t) { ta.innerHTML = t || ''; return ta.value; };
        var items = list.filter(function (w) { return (w.categories || []).some(function (c) { return /ready/i.test(c.slug + ' ' + c.name); }); }).map(function (w, i) {
          var minor = (w.prices && w.prices.currency_minor_unit != null) ? w.prices.currency_minor_unit : 2;
          var labels = (w.tags || []).concat(w.categories || []).map(function (t) { return (t.name + ' ' + t.slug).toLowerCase(); }).join(' ');
          var neg = /(no|free|without|non)[ -]*(pork)?[ -]*gelatin|gelatin[ -]*(free|less)/.test(labels);
          return { id: 'rw' + w.id, name: dec(w.name), gelatin: labels.indexOf('gelatin') !== -1 && !neg,
                   img: w.images && w.images[0] ? w.images[0].src : '', price: (w.prices ? parseInt(w.prices.price, 10) / Math.pow(10, minor) : 12.5) || 12.5, hue: (w.id * 61) % 360 };
        });

        PRODUCTS = items; render(); place();
        try { console.log('[FIKA ready-mix] loaded ' + items.length + ' products from WooCommerce'); } catch (e) {}
      })
      .catch(function () { try { console.log('[FIKA ready-mix] WooCommerce not found, showing the list in the script'); } catch (e) {} });
  }
  try { console.log('[FIKA ready-mix] ready'); } catch (e) {}
  } catch (err) { try { console.log('[FIKA ready-mix] error', err); } catch (e) {} }
})();

<script>
(function () {
  try {
  var PRICE_100G = 2.5, DELIVERY = 5, STEP = 100, CHECKOUT_URL = '/checkout';
  // Pull candies automatically from WooCommerce (add a product in WordPress and it appears here).
  // Price of each product = price per 100g. A product tagged or categorised "pork gelatin" gets the blue tab.
  var AUTO_FROM_WOOCOMMERCE = true;
  var GELATIN_WORD = 'gelatin';   // any tag/category containing this word marks pork gelatin

  // ======== YOUR CANDY LIST (name, gelatin true = contains pork gelatin, desc not shown, img = photo URL) ========
  var PRODUCTS = [
    { name:'Fizzy Cola',      gelatin:true,  img:'' },
    { name:'Loose Teeth',     gelatin:true,  img:'' },
    { name:'Fizzy Pop',       gelatin:true,  img:'' },
    { name:'Raspberry Bites', gelatin:true,  img:'' },
    { name:'Sample candy 5',  gelatin:false, img:'' },
    { name:'Sample candy 6',  gelatin:false, img:'' },
    { name:'Sample candy 7',  gelatin:false, img:'' },
    { name:'Sample candy 8',  gelatin:false, img:'' }
  ];

  var grid = document.getElementById('mxGrid');
  if (!grid) return;
  var KEY = 'fika_bag_v1', bag = {}, meta = {};
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  PRODUCTS.forEach(function (p, i) { p.id = 'p' + i; p.hue = (i * 47 + 330) % 360; });
  function loadBag() { try { var s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null'); if (s) { bag = s.bag || {}; meta = s.meta || {}; } } catch (e) {} }
  loadBag();
  // The bag is shared with the Ready-Mix block: items keep their own name and price per 100g
  function save() {
    Object.keys(bag).forEach(function (id) { var p = byId(id); if (p.name) meta[id] = { name: p.name, price: p.price || PRICE_100G }; });
    Object.keys(meta).forEach(function (id) { if (!bag[id]) delete meta[id]; });
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify({ bag: bag, meta: meta })); } catch (e) {}
    try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fikabag', { detail: 'mix' })); } catch (e) {}
  }
  window.addEventListener('fikabag', function (e) { if (e.detail === 'mix') return; loadBag(); render(); });
  function money(n) { return '$' + n.toFixed(2); }
  function gText(g) { return g >= 1000 ? (g / 1000) + ' kg' : g + 'g'; }
  function cost() { var c = 0; for (var k in bag) c += bag[k] / 100 * (byId(k).price || PRICE_100G); return c; }
  function total() { var t = 0; for (var k in bag) t += bag[k]; return t; }
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"' }[c]; }); }
  function byId(id) { for (var i = 0; i < PRODUCTS.length; i++) if (PRODUCTS[i].id === id) return PRODUCTS[i]; return meta[id] || {}; }
  function pixel(ev, x) { try { if (typeof window.fbq === 'function') window.fbq('track', ev, x); } catch (e) {} }

  function img(p) {
    if (p.img) return '<img decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="' + esc(p.img) + '" alt="' + esc(p.name) + '">';
    var s = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) s += '<i style="--x:' + (22 + ((i * 29 + p.hue) % 46)) + '%;--y:' + (24 + ((i * 41 + p.hue / 2) % 46)) + '%;--r:' + (((i * 67 + p.hue) % 120) - 60) + 'deg"></i>';
    return '<div class="mx-ph" style="--h:' + p.hue + '">' + s + '</div>';
  }
  function renderGrid() {
    $('mxCount').textContent = PRODUCTS.length + ' products';
    var keep = grid.scrollLeft;
    grid.innerHTML = PRODUCTS.map(function (p) {
      var g = bag[p.id] || 0;
      return '<article class="mx-card' + (g ? ' has' : '') + '" data-id="' + p.id + '"><div class="mx-img">' +
        (p.gelatin ? '<span class="mx-badge">Pork Gelatin</span>' : '') + img(p) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="mx-body"><h3 class="mx-name">' + esc(p.name) + '</h3><div class="mx-price">' + money(p.price || PRICE_100G) + '</div>' +
        (g ? '<div class="mx-pill"><button type="button" data-a="-" aria-label="Less">−</button><span>' + gText(g) + '</span><button type="button" data-a="+" aria-label="More">+</button></div>'
           : '<button type="button" class="mx-add" data-a="+">Add to bag</button>') + '</div></article>';
    }).join('');
    grid.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto'; grid.scrollLeft = keep; grid.style.scrollBehavior = '';
    place();
  }

  // ---- horizontal scroll: arrows, drag, progress ----
  var prev = $('mxPrev'), next = $('mxNext'), prog = $('mxProg');
  function place() {
    var max = grid.scrollWidth - grid.clientWidth, x = grid.scrollLeft;
    prev.disabled = x < 4; next.disabled = x > max - 4;
    var w = Math.max(8, grid.clientWidth / Math.max(grid.scrollWidth, 1) * 100);
    prog.style.width = w + '%';
    prog.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (max > 0 ? (x / max) * (100 / w * 100 - 100) : 0) + '%)';
    var img0 = grid.querySelector('.mx-img');
    if (img0) { var top = img0.offsetTop + img0.offsetHeight / 2; prev.style.top = next.style.top = top + 'px'; }
  }
  function by(dir) { var c = grid.querySelector('.mx-card'); var step = c ? c.getBoundingClientRect().width + parseFloat(getComputedStyle(grid).columnGap || 0) : grid.clientWidth * .8; grid.scrollBy({ left: dir * step * (window.innerWidth > 1100 ? 2 : 1), behavior: 'smooth' }); }
  prev.addEventListener('click', function () { by(-1); });
  next.addEventListener('click', function () { by(1); });
  grid.addEventListener('scroll', place, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', place);
  var down = false, sx = 0, sl = 0, moved = false;
  grid.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse' || e.target.closest('button')) return; down = true; moved = false; sx = e.clientX; sl = grid.scrollLeft; });
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (!down) return; var dx = e.clientX - sx; if (Math.abs(dx) > 4) { moved = true; grid.classList.add('drag'); } if (moved) grid.scrollLeft = sl - dx; });
  window.addEventListener('pointerup', function () { if (!down) return; down = false; if (grid.classList.contains('drag')) { grid.classList.remove('drag'); var c = grid.querySelector('.mx-card'); if (c) { var st = c.getBoundingClientRect().width + parseFloat(getComputedStyle(grid).columnGap || 0); grid.scrollTo({ left: Math.round(grid.scrollLeft / st) * st, behavior: 'smooth' }); } } });
  grid.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest('button[data-a]'); if (!b) return;
    var id = b.closest('.mx-card').getAttribute('data-id'), cur = bag[id] || 0;
    if (b.getAttribute('data-a') === '+') { bag[id] = cur + STEP; bump(); pixel('AddToCart', { value: byId(id).price || PRICE_100G, currency: 'USD', content_name: byId(id).name }); }
    else { bag[id] = Math.max(0, cur - STEP); if (!bag[id]) delete bag[id]; }
    save(); render();
  });

  var drawer = $('mxDrawer'), veil = $('mxVeil'), fab = $('mxFab');
  function openD() { drawer.classList.add('on'); veil.classList.add('on'); }
  function closeD() { drawer.classList.remove('on'); veil.classList.remove('on'); }
  function bump() { fab.classList.remove('bump'); void fab.offsetWidth; fab.classList.add('bump'); }
  fab.addEventListener('click', openD); veil.addEventListener('click', closeD); $('mxClose').addEventListener('click', closeD);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeD(); });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target.closest('.fika-cart')) { e.preventDefault(); openD(); } });
  $('mxClear').addEventListener('click', function () { bag = {}; save(); render(); });
  $('mxItems').addEventListener('click', function (e) { var b = e.target.closest('.mx-rm'); if (!b) return; delete bag[b.getAttribute('data-id')]; save(); render(); });
  $('mxGo').setAttribute('href', CHECKOUT_URL);
  $('mxGo').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var sub = cost(); if (!sub) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
    pixel('InitiateCheckout', { value: sub + DELIVERY, currency: 'USD', num_items: Object.keys(bag).length });
  });

  function renderBag() {
    var html = '';
    Object.keys(bag).forEach(function (id) {
      html += '<div class="mx-line"><div>' + esc(byId(id).name) + '<small>' + gText(bag[id]) + '</small></div><div>' + money(bag[id] / 100 * (byId(id).price || PRICE_100G)) + '</div><button class="mx-rm" data-id="' + id + '" type="button" aria-label="Remove">×</button></div>';
    });
    $('mxItems').innerHTML = html || '<div class="mx-none">Your bag is empty.</div>';
    var g = total(), sub = cost(), has = g > 0;
    var kg = (g / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' kg';
    $('mxKg').textContent = kg; $('mxFabN').textContent = kg;
    $('mxSub').textContent = money(sub); $('mxDel').textContent = money(has ? DELIVERY : 0); $('mxTot').textContent = money(has ? sub + DELIVERY : 0);
    $('mxGo').setAttribute('aria-disabled', has ? 'false' : 'true');
  }
  function render() { renderGrid(); renderBag(); }

  function fitX(el) {
    el.style.setProperty('margin-left', '0px', 'important'); el.style.setProperty('margin-right', '0px', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('max-width', 'none', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('width', document.documentElement.clientWidth + 'px', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('margin-left', (-el.getBoundingClientRect().left) + 'px', 'important');
  }
  function fitAll() { try { Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.mx-page'), fitX); place(); } catch (e) {} }
  window.addEventListener('resize', fitAll); window.addEventListener('load', fitAll);
  setTimeout(fitAll, 400); setTimeout(fitAll, 1500);
  render(); fitAll(); place(); setTimeout(place, 500);

  if (AUTO_FROM_WOOCOMMERCE && window.fetch) {
    fetch('/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=100&orderby=menu_order&order=asc', { credentials: 'same-origin' })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('no store api'); return r.json(); })
      .then(function (list) {
        if (!list || !list.length) return;
        var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
        var dec = function (t) { ta.innerHTML = t || ''; return ta.value; };
        var items = list.filter(function (w) { return !(w.categories || []).some(function (c) { return /ready/i.test(c.slug + ' ' + c.name); }); }).map(function (w) {
          var minor = (w.prices && w.prices.currency_minor_unit != null) ? w.prices.currency_minor_unit : 2;
          var price = w.prices ? parseInt(w.prices.price, 10) / Math.pow(10, minor) : PRICE_100G;
          var labels = (w.tags || []).concat(w.categories || []).map(function (t) { return (t.name + ' ' + t.slug).toLowerCase(); }).join(' ');
          var neg = /(no|free|without|non)[ -]*(pork)?[ -]*gelatin|gelatin[ -]*(free|less)/.test(labels);
          return { id: 'w' + w.id, name: dec(w.name), gelatin: labels.indexOf(GELATIN_WORD) !== -1 && !neg,
                   img: w.images && w.images[0] ? w.images[0].src : '', price: price || PRICE_100G, hue: (w.id * 47) % 360 };
        });
        if (!items.length) return;
        PRODUCTS = items;
        Object.keys(bag).forEach(function (k) { if (/^[pw]/.test(k) && !byId(k).name) delete bag[k]; });
        save(); render(); place();
        try { console.log('[FIKA mix] loaded ' + items.length + ' products from WooCommerce'); } catch (e) {}
      })
      .catch(function () { try { console.log('[FIKA mix] WooCommerce not found, showing the list in the script'); } catch (e) {} });
  }
  try { console.log('[FIKA mix page] ready'); } catch (e) {}
  } catch (err) { try { console.log('[FIKA mix page] error', err); } catch (e) {} }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  try {
  var BAG_G = 500;              // one ready-mix bag = 500g
  var AUTO_FROM_WOOCOMMERCE = true;   // reads products from the WooCommerce category with "ready" in its name or slug
  // ======== READY-MIX LIST (used until WooCommerce products exist). price = price of one 500g bag ========
  var PRODUCTS = [
    { name:'Ready Sweet & Sour Mix', gelatin:false, price:12.5, img:'' },
    { name:'Ready Sour Mix',         gelatin:false, price:12.5, img:'' },
    { name:'Ready Sweet Mix',        gelatin:false, price:12.5, img:'' }
  ];

  var KEY = 'fika_bag_v1';
  var grid = document.getElementById('rmGrid'); if (!grid) return;
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  function read() { try { var s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null'); if (s) return { bag: s.bag || {}, meta: s.meta || {} }; } catch (e) {} return { bag: {}, meta: {} }; }
  function write(st) { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(st)); } catch (e) {} try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fikabag', { detail: 'ready' })); } catch (e) {} }
  function money(n) { return '$' + n.toFixed(2); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"' }[c]; }); }
  function gText(g) { return g >= 1000 ? (g / 1000) + ' kg' : g + 'g'; }
  function pixel(ev, x) { try { if (typeof window.fbq === 'function') window.fbq('track', ev, x); } catch (e) {} }
  function setIds() { PRODUCTS.forEach(function (p, i) { if (!p.id) p.id = 'r' + i; p.hue = p.hue != null ? p.hue : (i * 61 + 340) % 360; }); }
  setIds();

  function img(p) {
    if (p.img) return '<img decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="' + esc(p.img) + '" alt="' + esc(p.name) + '">';
    var s = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) s += '<i style="--x:' + (22 + ((i * 29 + p.hue) % 46)) + '%;--y:' + (24 + ((i * 41 + p.hue / 2) % 46)) + '%;--r:' + (((i * 67 + p.hue) % 120) - 60) + 'deg"></i>';
    return '<div class="mx-ph" style="--h:' + p.hue + '">' + s + '</div>';
  }
  function sorted() { return PRODUCTS.slice(); }
  function render() {
    var st = read(), keep = grid.scrollLeft;
    $('rmCount').textContent = PRODUCTS.length + ' product' + (PRODUCTS.length === 1 ? '' : 's');
    grid.innerHTML = sorted().map(function (p) {
      var g = st.bag[p.id] || 0;
      return '<article class="mx-card' + (g ? ' has' : '') + '" data-id="' + esc(p.id) + '"><div class="mx-img"><span class="mx-badge">' + (p.gelatin ? 'Pork Gelatin' : 'Gelatin Free') + '</span>' + img(p) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="mx-body"><h3 class="mx-name">' + esc(p.name) + '</h3><div class="mx-price">From ' + money(p.price) + '</div>' +
        (g ? '<div class="mx-pill"><button type="button" data-a="-" aria-label="Less">−</button><span>' + (g / BAG_G) + ' × ' + BAG_G + 'g</span><button type="button" data-a="+" aria-label="More">+</button></div>'
           : '<button type="button" class="mx-add" data-a="+">Add to bag</button>') + '</div></article>';
    }).join('');
    grid.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto'; grid.scrollLeft = keep; grid.style.scrollBehavior = '';
    place();
  }
  function byId(id) { for (var i = 0; i < PRODUCTS.length; i++) if (PRODUCTS[i].id === id) return PRODUCTS[i]; return {}; }
  grid.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest('button[data-a]'); if (!b) return;
    var id = b.closest('.mx-card').getAttribute('data-id'), p = byId(id), st = read(), cur = st.bag[id] || 0;
    if (b.getAttribute('data-a') === '+') {
      st.bag[id] = cur + BAG_G; st.meta[id] = { name: p.name, price: p.price / (BAG_G / 100) };
      pixel('AddToCart', { value: p.price, currency: 'USD', content_name: p.name });
      var f = document.getElementById('mxFab'); if (f) { f.classList.remove('bump'); void f.offsetWidth; f.classList.add('bump'); }
    } else { st.bag[id] = Math.max(0, cur - BAG_G); if (!st.bag[id]) { delete st.bag[id]; delete st.meta[id]; } }
    write(st); render();
  });
  window.addEventListener('fikabag', function (e) { if (e.detail !== 'ready') render(); });

  // ---- horizontal scroll ----
  var prev = $('rmPrev'), next = $('rmNext'), prog = $('rmProg');
  function place() {
    var max = grid.scrollWidth - grid.clientWidth, x = grid.scrollLeft;
    prev.disabled = x < 4; next.disabled = x > max - 4;
    var w = Math.min(100, Math.max(8, grid.clientWidth / Math.max(grid.scrollWidth, 1) * 100));
    prog.style.width = w + '%';
    prog.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (max > 0 ? (x / max) * (100 / w * 100 - 100) : 0) + '%)';
    var i0 = grid.querySelector('.mx-img');
    if (i0) { var top = i0.offsetTop + i0.offsetHeight / 2; prev.style.top = next.style.top = top + 'px'; }
  }
  function step() { var c = grid.querySelector('.mx-card'); return c ? c.getBoundingClientRect().width + parseFloat(getComputedStyle(grid).columnGap || 0) : grid.clientWidth * .8; }
  prev.addEventListener('click', function () { grid.scrollBy({ left: -step() * (window.innerWidth > 1100 ? 2 : 1), behavior: 'smooth' }); });
  next.addEventListener('click', function () { grid.scrollBy({ left: step() * (window.innerWidth > 1100 ? 2 : 1), behavior: 'smooth' }); });
  grid.addEventListener('scroll', place, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', place);
  var down = false, sx = 0, sl = 0, moved = false;
  grid.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse' || e.target.closest('button')) return; down = true; moved = false; sx = e.clientX; sl = grid.scrollLeft; });
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (!down) return; var dx = e.clientX - sx; if (Math.abs(dx) > 4) { moved = true; grid.classList.add('drag'); } if (moved) grid.scrollLeft = sl - dx; });
  window.addEventListener('pointerup', function () { if (!down) return; down = false; if (grid.classList.contains('drag')) { grid.classList.remove('drag'); var st = step(); grid.scrollTo({ left: Math.round(grid.scrollLeft / st) * st, behavior: 'smooth' }); } });

  function fitX(el) {
    el.style.setProperty('margin-left', '0px', 'important'); el.style.setProperty('margin-right', '0px', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('max-width', 'none', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('width', document.documentElement.clientWidth + 'px', 'important');
    el.style.setProperty('margin-left', (-el.getBoundingClientRect().left) + 'px', 'important');
  }
  function fitAll() { try { fitX($('rmPage')); place(); } catch (e) {} }
  window.addEventListener('resize', fitAll); window.addEventListener('load', fitAll);
  setTimeout(fitAll, 400); setTimeout(fitAll, 1500);
  render(); fitAll();

  if (AUTO_FROM_WOOCOMMERCE && window.fetch) {
    fetch('/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=100&orderby=menu_order&order=asc', { credentials: 'same-origin' })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('no store api'); return r.json(); })
      .then(function (list) {
        var ta = document.createElement('textarea'), dec = function (t) { ta.innerHTML = t || ''; return ta.value; };
        var items = list.filter(function (w) { return (w.categories || []).some(function (c) { return /ready/i.test(c.slug + ' ' + c.name); }); }).map(function (w, i) {
          var minor = (w.prices && w.prices.currency_minor_unit != null) ? w.prices.currency_minor_unit : 2;
          var labels = (w.tags || []).concat(w.categories || []).map(function (t) { return (t.name + ' ' + t.slug).toLowerCase(); }).join(' ');
          var neg = /(no|free|without|non)[ -]*(pork)?[ -]*gelatin|gelatin[ -]*(free|less)/.test(labels);
          return { id: 'rw' + w.id, name: dec(w.name), gelatin: labels.indexOf('gelatin') !== -1 && !neg,
                   img: w.images && w.images[0] ? w.images[0].src : '', price: (w.prices ? parseInt(w.prices.price, 10) / Math.pow(10, minor) : 12.5) || 12.5, hue: (w.id * 61) % 360 };
        });
        if (!items.length) return;
        PRODUCTS = items; render(); place();
        try { console.log('[FIKA ready-mix] loaded ' + items.length + ' products from WooCommerce'); } catch (e) {}
      })
      .catch(function () { try { console.log('[FIKA ready-mix] WooCommerce not found, showing the list in the script'); } catch (e) {} });
  }
  try { console.log('[FIKA ready-mix] ready'); } catch (e) {}
  } catch (err) { try { console.log('[FIKA ready-mix] error', err); } catch (e) {} }
})();
</script>
